reasoning: Plan A is the better choice for a trail runner aiming to become faster. While both plans involve a similar total training time, Plan A incorporates a wider variety of training stimuli, including tempo runs and threshold efforts, which are crucial for improving speed and lactate threshold. Plan B relies almost exclusively on easy trail runs, which are good for building base endurance but won't significantly improve speed. The inclusion of cross-training in Plan A also provides a valuable recovery tool while maintaining aerobic fitness.
